title: BochaoKong/classical-complex-wpt
summary: A Mathlib-only Lean 4 formalization of the classical complex-analytic Weierstrass preparation theorem at the origin. For every number of base variables and every preparation degree, including the zero-dimensional and degree-zero cases, it constructs the distinguished monic polynomial and nonvanishing analytic unit and proves uniqueness of all factors as germs.

review.reason: Mathlib-based Lean formalization of the complex Weierstrass preparation theorem.
